name: cybertalks
description: Searchable archive of cybersecurity conference talks, with video and written summaries.

scripts.build: npm run validate && npm run generate-shards && next build
scripts.generate-shards: node scripts/generate-summary-shards.mjs && node scripts/generate-talk-index-shards.mjs && tsx scripts/generate-catalog-shards.ts
scripts.preview:d1: opennextjs-cloudflare build --config wrangler.d1-preview.jsonc && opennextjs-cloudflare preview --config wrangler.d1-preview.jsonc
scripts.deploy: tsx scripts/check-deploy-target.ts && opennextjs-cloudflare build && opennextjs-cloudflare deploy
scripts.upload: tsx scripts/check-deploy-target.ts && opennextjs-cloudflare build && opennextjs-cloudflare upload
